
## Feudal Wars buildings (CC0)

Artwork by Feudal Wars, released under CC0 1.0. Downloaded 2026-10-08 from
OpenGameArt. The exact source pages, download URLs and SHA-256 hashes are in
`assets/third_party/feudal_wars/sources.json`. Images are unmodified; the game
scales them and dims unbuilt sites at runtime.

- https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-barracks-isometric-25d
- https://opengameart.org/content/western-european-castle-isometric-25d
- https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-archery-range-isometric-25d
- https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-stable-isometric-25d
- https://opengameart.org/content/western-european-medieval-houses-isometric-25d
